input:
EARLIER SCENES (context only):
在古代，很多医生不知道怎么用药。所以他们找到了很多植物对药。神农先看到很多病人，他们吃很多植物对药。但是我觉得他们的吃的植物，让他们病人。神农觉得这个植物可能特别是毒。所以他想找一个植物对药，他们可以吃对药。正好，他找到了一把花，他想把花放在茶里，对药。
他不知道如果这把花对你的身体好，这就要看如果这把花毒不毒了。神农想找别的植物，但是这很麻烦。正好，他找到了别的花。他一吃花，很快就生病了。他的肚子疼死了。神农不知道他吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃。
CURRENT SCENE:
别的人给了神农一个灵芝。这个植物可以让神农更好。比方说，他会觉得更健康。吃灵芝以后，他可以再走。现在他觉得更好。最后，神农找到了很多植物，他可以用对药。这些植物让神农很高兴。神农想跟很多人分享他的新药。

FLAGGED PLACES:

[P272] 别的人给了神农一【个】灵芝
  proposed by the AI checker: 别的人给了神农一[个→朵]灵芝 (灵芝 normally uses the measure word 朵)
  her past correction (le_completed): 他给[+了]神农灵芝 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction (ask_request_verbs): 神农[问人帮他→请人]给他灵芝 — her note: the “ask” in “ask for help” is not问
  her past correction (le_completed): 他们给[+了]神农灵芝 — her note: 了completed
  rule card le_completed: Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb. Not an error: Do not flag an action just because it has a verb: if it is not about completion, no 了. An ongoing action can use 着 instead of 了.
  rule card ask_request_verbs: 问 is for asking a question. For “ask for help,” use 请人 or 找别人帮忙; for “ask somebody to do something,” use 请 or 让. Not an error: Do not flag 问 when the meaning is asking a question.

[P273] 这个植物可以让神农【^】更好
  proposed by the correction model: 这个植物可以让神农[+变得]更好
  her past correction (le_completed): 神农的朋友给[+了]他这植物 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction (modifier_de_structure): 神农加下去很多[-的]植物
  her past correction (modifier_de_structure): 所以神农去找[一些植物，对身体有好处→一些对身体有好处的植物]
  rule card modifier_de_structure: Use 的 after a modifier when it describes a noun, especially a longer phrase such as 人类创造的文明 or 能吃的植物. Do not add 的 after quantity words or fixed modifiers where it is not needed, such as 很多人, 一些人, 今天清晨, 蓝色衣服, and 好主意. Not an error: Do not flag 的 in modifiers that need it, such as 有毒的植物, 中国的植物, or 穿着蓝色衣服的人. Do not add 的 after short fixed modifiers such as 很多, 一些, 今天, 蓝色, or 好 in the examples shown.
  rule card le_completed: Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb. Not an error: Do not flag an action just because it has a verb: if it is not about completion, no 了. An ongoing action can use 着 instead of 了.

[P274] 【吃】灵芝以后
  proposed by the AI checker: [吃→吃了]灵芝以后 (a specific completed eating action usually takes 了)
  proposed by the correction model: 吃[+了]灵芝以后
  her past correction (le_completed): 神农[吃→吃了]灵芝以后 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction (verb_object_valency): 灵芝一吃[+灵芝]就正好
  her past correction (collocation_selection): 灵芝一吃[就正好→身体就好了]
  rule card le_completed: Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb. Not an error: Do not flag an action just because it has a verb: if it is not about completion, no 了. An ongoing action can use 着 instead of 了.
  rule card verb_object_valency: Use the verb structure that the verb allows: give it the needed object, and do not add an extra object after a V.+Obj. compound or complement. For example, 跑遍 + place, while 掉 cannot take an object by itself. Not an error: Do not flag 掉 when it is a resultative complement after another main action verb. 掉 can also be used in the structure 掉 + directional + place.

[P275] 现在他觉得更好【^】
  proposed by the correction model: 现在他觉得更好[+了]
  her past correction (collocation_selection): [神农→感觉]越来越好
  her past correction (zero_redundant_pronoun): [-他们的]身体越来越好 — her note: redundant
  her past correction (le_completed): 感觉得身体健康[+了]
  rule card collocation_selection: Use words with their normal collocations: a word must naturally match the noun, person, thing, action, or situation it describes. A grammatically possible combination may still sound unnatural in Chinese.
  rule card zero_redundant_pronoun: When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是. Not an error: Do not delete a subject when it is needed before 不是……而是……; place it before 不是 instead.

[P276] 他可以【用对药】
  proposed by the AI checker: 他可以[用对药→用来做药] (用 needs 用来做药 here)
  proposed by the correction model: 他可以用[对→这些]药
  her past correction (le_completed): [给→给了]他一些药 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction (ambiguous_pronoun): ⟦它⟧可以做药 — her note: “它“ is unclear, it seems that it refers to夹竹桃，which is a poison, not a medicine
  her past correction (zero_redundant_pronoun): [-他]看到了药 — her note: redundant
  rule card le_completed: Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb. Not an error: Do not flag an action just because it has a verb: if it is not about completion, no 了. An ongoing action can use 着 instead of 了.
  rule card ambiguous_pronoun: Use 他/她/它/他们 only when it is clear who or what they refer to. If more than one person or thing is possible, repeat the name or use a clear noun phrase. Not an error: A pronoun is fine when its referent is close and unambiguous. Do not use 你 for a story character when it refers to the reader instead.

places.reason: 个 is acceptable for a beginner here.
让神农更好 is grammatical and natural.
The eating is a completed narrative action.
了 marks the resulting change of state.
用对药 does not express using plants to make medicine.
